rule: Do it through the desktop with the mouse and keyboard, not with a shell or a script. Do not ask questions. When it is finished, reply with the single word DONE.

tasks.instruction: Open Notepad, type the text: legato bench 8301, and save it as bench-note.txt on the Desktop.
Using File Explorer, create a folder named Reports on the Desktop, and inside it a new text document named summary.txt.
In Windows Settings, change the time zone to (UTC-10:00) Hawaii.
Open WordPad, type the line: Quarterly Report, make that line bold, and save the document as report.rtf on the Desktop.
Create a shortcut on the Desktop named Editor that opens Notepad (notepad.exe).
Open Calculator and multiply 4827 by 96. Then write the result in Notepad and save it as product.txt on the Desktop.
